verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֶל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים בְּטֶ֛רֶם יַכֶּ֥ה פַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת־ עַזָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’el- pə·liš·tîm bə·ṭe·rem yak·keh p̄ar·‘ōh ’eṯ- ‘az·zāh
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines before Pharaoh struck down Gaza
verses.literalPt: A palavra que da parte de Jeová veio a Jeremias acerca dos filisteus, antes que Faraó ferisse a Gaza.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנֵּה־ מַ֜יִם עֹלִ֤ים מִצָּפוֹן֙ וְהָיוּ֙ לְנַ֣חַל שׁוֹטֵ֔ף וְיִשְׁטְפוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֔הּ עִ֖יר וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְזָֽעֲקוּ֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְהֵילִ֕ל כֹּ֖ל יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nêh- ma·yim ‘ō·lîm miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·hā·yū lə·na·ḥal šō·w·ṭêp̄ wə·yiš·ṭə·p̄ū ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·w·’āh ‘îr wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh wə·zā·‘ă·qū hā·’ā·ḏām wə·hê·lil kōl yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says See how the waters are rising from the north and becoming an overflowing torrent They will overflow the land and its fullness the cities and their inhabitants The people will cry out and all who dwell in the land will wail
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Eis que do norte se levantam as águas, e se converterão em torrente trasbordante, e trasbordarão a terra e quanto há nela, a cidade e os que nela habitam; os homens clamarão, e todos os habitantes da terra uivarão.

verses.original: מִקּ֗וֹל שַֽׁעֲטַת֙ פַּרְס֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔יו מֵרַ֣עַשׁ לְרִכְבּ֔וֹ הֲמ֖וֹן גַּלְגִּלָּ֑יו לֹֽא־ הִפְנ֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ אֶל־ בָּנִ֔ים מֵֽרִפְי֖וֹן יָדָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl ša·‘ă·ṭaṯ par·sō·wṯ ’ab·bî·rāw mê·ra·‘aš lə·riḵ·bōw hă·mō·wn gal·gil·lāw lō- hip̄·nū ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ’el- bā·nîm mê·rip̄·yō·wn yā·ḏā·yim
verses.literal: at the sound of the galloping hooves of stallions the rumbling of chariots and the clatter of their wheels The fathers will not turn back for their sons their hands will hang limp
verses.literalPt: Ao som do bater dos pés dos seus cavalos, ao estrépito dos seus carros, ao estrondo das suas rodas, os pais não atendem aos filhos por serem fracas as suas mãos;

verses.original: עַל־ הַיּ֗וֹם הַבָּא֙ לִשְׁד֣וֹד אֶת־ כָּל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְהַכְרִ֤ית לְצֹר֙ וּלְצִיד֔וֹן כֹּ֖ל שָׂרִ֣יד עֹזֵ֑ר כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שְׁאֵרִ֖ית אִ֥י כַפְתּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hay·yō·wm hab·bā liš·ḏō·wḏ ’eṯ- kāl- pə·liš·tîm lə·haḵ·rîṯ lə·ṣōr ū·lə·ṣî·ḏō·wn kōl śā·rîḏ ‘ō·zêr kî- šō·ḏêḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm šə·’ê·rîṯ ’î ḵap̄·tō·wr
verses.literal: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every remaining ally Indeed the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor
verses.literalPt: e porque vem vindo o dia para despojar a todos os filisteus, de exterminar de Tiro e de Sidom a todos os aliados que ficarem; pois Jeová despojará os filisteus, ao resto da ilha de Caftor.

verses.original: בָּ֤אָה קָרְחָה֙ אֶל־ עַזָּ֔ה נִדְמְתָ֥ה אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית עִמְקָ֑ם עַד־ מָתַ֖י תִּתְגּוֹדָֽדִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: bā·’āh qā·rə·ḥāh ’el- ‘az·zāh niḏ·mə·ṯāh ’aš·qə·lō·wn šə·’ê·rîṯ ‘im·qām ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay tiṯ·gō·w·ḏā·ḏî
verses.literal: The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning Ashkelon will be silenced O remnant of their valley how long . . . will you gash yourself
verses.literalPt: A calvície é vinda sobre Gaza; Asquelom é reduzida a nada, bem como o resto do seu vale; até quando te sarjarás?

verses.original: ה֗וֹי חֶ֚רֶב לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַד־ אָ֖נָה לֹ֣א תִשְׁקֹ֑טִי הֵאָֽסְפִי֙ אַל־ תַּעְרֵ֔ךְ הֵרָגְעִ֖י וָדֹֽמִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ḥe·reḇ Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh lō ṯiš·qō·ṭî hê·’ā·sə·p̄î ’al- ta‘·rêḵ hê·rā·ḡə·‘î wā·ḏōm·mî
verses.literal: Alas O sword of the LORD how long . . . until you rest . . . Return to your sheath cease and be still
verses.literalPt: Ó espada de Jeová, até quando deixarás de repousar? Entra na tua bainha; descansa e fica quieta.

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תִּשְׁקֹ֔טִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה צִוָּה־ לָ֑הּ אֶֽל־ אַשְׁקְל֛וֹן וְאֶל־ ח֥וֹף הַיָּ֖ם שָׁ֥ם יְעָדָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ tiš·qō·ṭî Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh- lāh ’el- ’aš·qə·lō·wn wə·’el- ḥō·wp̄ hay·yām šām yə·‘ā·ḏāh
verses.literal: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it He has appointed it against Ashkelon . . . and the shore of its coastland . . .
verses.literalPt: Como poderá ficar quieta, visto que Jeová te deu um encargo? Contra Asquelom, e contra a costa marítima, é que ele a enviou.
